Name: Horse Overhaul - Thin - Faster - Saddle Bags - Friendship
Author: Goldenrevolver
Description:
[size=3][color=#6aa84f]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.7 and SMAPI 4.0.8. Source available on Github:
[/color][url=https://github.com/Goldenrevolver/Stardew-Valley-Mods]https://github.com/Goldenrevolver/Stardew-Valley-Mods[/url]
If you want to buy me coffee, I now have a [url=https://ko-fi.com/goldenrevolver]ko-fi[/url].


This mod aims to be the one stop place for everything you need for your horse apart from texture replacers.

It combines, balances and expands upon the features of:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Thin Horse mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1232]Pony Weight Loss Program[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10446]Horse Squeeze[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Faster Horse mods like ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7537]Secretariat[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2791]Faster Horse[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Horse ﻿Friendship and Feeding mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5242]Upgraded Horse[/url] (which is partly included, see credits)[/size]
[*][size=3]A menu to check on your horse (and optionally also your pet) like many information mods[/size]
[/list][size=3]
And it's also completely configurable to your liking.

This also works in (local and online) multiplayer but it's [color=#ffd966]required [/color]to be installed by the host and it's recommended to use the same settings for everyone who is using the mod (except visuals and keybinds of course).


[b][b]Feature [/b]1: Thin Horse:[/b]

Pony Weight Loss Program was a hugely successful mod, even if its bandaid fix for the horse hitbox would run into the same issues as the base game's fence gate interaction. This feature replaces the horse hitbox with an actual 1x1 hitbox when facing in every direction.

[color=#6aa84f]Compatible [/color]with horse reskins (my vanilla friendly favorites: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1200]Horsemanship[/url]﻿ or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1]The Mane Event - Horse Customizer[/url]).
[color=#6aa84f]Compatible [/color]with[color=#6aa84f] [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url].

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/7911/7911-1612215504-1835199801.gif[/img]


[b]Feature 2: (Limited) interaction while riding your horse:[/b]

This feature allows you to interact with a select few objects while on horseback. I chose these based on their usefulness and how unlikely they are to cause incompatibilities and issues. If you think you should be able to do something else while riding your horse let me know:
[list]
[*][size=3]picking up foraging items (including spring onions and excluding ginger)[/size]
[*]interacting with trees and tappers
[*]interacting with mushroom logs and boxes
[*]interacting with fruit trees
[*]interacting with bushes
[*]interacting with trash cans (disabled by default)
[/list]
[b]Feature 3: Warp your horse with you:[/b]

When you want to use your horse a lot, warp totems, warp obelisks and the scepter of return become quite annoying, even when you already have the horse flute. With this feature, if you use these items and objects while your horse is close to you, it will also be warped with you. If this seems too powerful, you can configure that it requires the horse flute (either in your inventory or simply bought and stored somewhere).
Affects:
[list]
[*][size=3]warp totems[/size]
[*][size=3]warp obelisks[/size]
[*][size=3]mini obelisks[/size]
[*][size=3]scepter of return[/size]
[/list]
[b][b]Feature 4[/b]: Saddle Bags:[/b]

This is a completely new addition as far as I know. This allows your horse to carry items for you, similar to how it worked in Harvest Moon FoMT. Unlike in FoMT you can take items out of the saddle bags again. Simply use the tool use key on your horse while you are not holding food (see below for why) to open it.

There is also an option for visible saddle bags on your horse, originally released as its [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8018]own mod[/url] by DegenerateFreak. The color options are [color=#6aa84f]green [/color]and [color=#b45f06]brown [/color]as well as two color options specifically for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1200]Horsemanship[/url] ([color=#e69138]horsemanship_brown [/color]and [color=#ffd966]horsemanship_beige[/color]). Additional options for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1]The Mane Event - Horse Customizer[/url]﻿ are planned.

If you think this is too powerful, you can enable an option that you have to unlock them first.
[color=#6aa84f]Compatible [/color]with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9791]Better Chests[/url], allowing saddle bags to be tweaked separately. If you want to change their size or a bunch of other things, check it out.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/7911/7911-1612915511-979887784.gif[/img]


[b][b]Feature [/b]5: Friendship:[/b]

This gives your horse a friendship stat like your pet or your coop and barn animals (0 to 5 hearts/ 0 to 1000 points like vanilla). There are various ways to increase the friendship with your horse, but don't worry, [color=#6aa84f]there are no ways to decrease it[/color]. There is also a new menu to check on your horse which can be opened with a configurable hotkey (default: H). This message can be translated. Let me know if you want to write a small translation and I can upload it.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/7911/7911-1612638708-955570608.png[/img]


[b]Feature 5.1: Movement Speed:[/b]

This is the main reward for increasing friendship with your horse. The higher the friendship with your horse the higher its movement speed. The maximum value can be adjusted in the config. Works in addition to the 1.6 features of increasing horse movement speed. This of course pairs very well with the 'Thin Horse' feature.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/7911/7911-1612217787-1652790559.gif[/img]
(This is max friendship, the default max speed of 3 and a coffee speed bonus)


[b]FEATURE 5.2: Ways of increasing friendship:[/b]

There are 4 ways of increasing friendship.
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]You can pet your horse once a day (this will be done automatically when you try to ride it for the first time, compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/859]Better Ranching[/url]﻿)[/size]
[*][size=3]You can fill its freshly fixed water trough (similar to the pet bowl)[/size]
[*][size=3]You can feed it an edible item (with the tool use key)[/size]
[*][size=3]You can place a heater next to the stable (one tile around it) to gain a small amount of friendship every day in the winter[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7397]﻿[/url][/size]
[/list][size=3]
(if you are using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1478]Hudson Valley Buildings[/url]﻿ or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/928]Seasonal Vanilla Buildings[/url] (unofficial update), I made it so you don't have to place a heater as those stable skins already include one) 

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/7911/7911-1612215495-1854368711.gif[/img]

Petting and giving water grants the default values of friendship.

You can feed your horse an item once a day (this limitation can be disabled in the config) to gain a small amount of extra friendship.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/7911/7911-1612217923-143025150.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/7911/7911-1612217932-1459620590.png[/img]

Prior to update 1.4, giving food granted a variable amount of friendship based on the health the item would recover to the player. This was unrealistic and a bit unbalanced, but if you prefer this simple approach you can enable it again in the config by disabling the "New Food System" setting.

In update 1.4 feeding an item to the horse was completely rewritten.
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]every fruit, vegetable and foraging good was ranked on whether horses in real life could and should eat it and they all got a hand balanced amount of friendship to grant. This will also be reflected in the message popup by saying your horse loves/ likes/ dislikes that item.[/size]
[*][size=3]additionally, some non player edible items, like wheat, are now edible by the horse.[/size]
[*][size=3]on the downside, a lot of previously edible items that are dangerous to a horse's health can now no longer be fed to them. For those cases the mod will now tell you that this is not safe food for horses, so you can even learn a bit on the side.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[color=#6aa84f]On average you will get considerably more friendship for items and there are more good options to choose from.[/color] If you want to spoil the surprise you may open this spoiler card:

[spoiler]"Looking for a snack for your loyal equine companion but it's ignoring the mushrooms you've gathered?
Let's find out what your horse won't refuse and, while we are at it, what you shouldn't offer in the first place.
Most fruits from around the valley are wonderful treats in moderation, but remember to stay away from rhubarb and peppers.
For vegetables you have to be careful of all kinds of cabbages, onions and nightshades, which include potatoes, tomatoes and eggplants,
but other than those, there are so many great options like most grains and favorites like carrots and beets.
Despite the name, horse radish is also a no go, while normal radish is perfectly fine.
Fiddlehead fern and amaranth as well as most flowers are poisonous for horses, but sunflower seeds and dandelions are excellent treats.
Of course, you shouldn't feed your horse dairy products, chocolate, coffee or meat of any kind."
[/spoiler]

[b][b]Feature [/b]6: Pet menu and pet feeding:[/b]

This simply adds the same menu and feeding mechanic I added to the horse to the pet (cat or dog). With the 1.4 update the acceptable cat and dog diet is now exclusively carnivorous to contrast the horse diet which is now exclusively herbivorous. In the base game this consists mostly of fish, but this setting is compatible with mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] that add meat items to the game (It's recommended to disable that mod's pet feeding feature in favor of this mod's one).

The pet menu has its own configurable hotkey (default: P).
Both pet feeding and the pet menu can be disabled in the config if you don't want them of course.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/7911/7911-1612638716-1001145737.png[/img]


[b]Feature 7: The horse leaves hoofsteps on snow and dust effects on dirt/ sand:[/b]

This feature may seem small, but it has an incredible effect on immersion and the feeling of impact and speed. Thank you for the suggestion and help, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9473360]VonLoewe[/url]! I'll add a gif at a later point to showcase this.

[*][size=3][color=#6aa84f]Compatible [/color]with horse reskins (my vanilla friendly favorites: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1200]Horsemanship[/url]﻿ or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1]The Mane Event - Horse Customizer[/url]﻿).[/size]
[*][size=3][color=#6aa84f]Compatible [/color]with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url] in every way I tested.﻿[/size]
[*][size=3][color=#6aa84f]Compatible [/color]with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23287]Where's My Horse[/url].[/size]

[b]Requirements:[/b]
[url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]: I built version 1.5.9 of this mod based on version 4.0.8. It should be compatible with a few future versions. You can get the latest version of SMAPI [url=https://smapi.io/]here[/url].


[b]Installation:[/b]
Install SMAPI. Then extract the content of the downloaded zip file into the SMAPI mods folder and start the game via the SMAPI launcher or Steam if you have set the launch option for SMAPI in Steam. The config file will be generated inside the folder of the mod. Close the game to edit it and restart the game.

You can also optionally use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to change the config ingame (only on the title screen except keybindings!) without the need to close and restart (otherwise you need to restart) but it is not required to be installed.

If you are using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]CJB Cheats Menu[/url] please remember to [color=#f1c232]rebind [/color]either the cheat menu key or the pet menu key as they are both P by default. Otherwise my mod will automatically unbind the pet menu so you can continue to use the cheat menu.


[b]Updating: [/b]
Simply delete the prior version, install the new one and check the updated config created after the first startup (Changes require restart to take effect if you have not made them with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]).

Most of the time, you can also just copy your old config file to the new version and it will work fine. Simply overwriting the old version generally also works (apart from keeping old unneeded assets on your hard drive), but is not a good habit because other mods, like CP mods, can have issues if you update them the same way.


[b]Uninstallation:[/b]
[color=#f1c232]Attention: Before uninstalling the mod [/color]disable the 'Saddle Bags' feature and then end the day to save. If you forgot items in your saddle bags when disabling the feature, they will be put into the 'lost and found' chest. If you don't do this, the chests that the mod uses to save the saddle bags will remain in an inaccessible part of the upper left corner of your farm (but you can easily remove them with for example a no clip mod).[/size]
